Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Preflight: patch gating & maintenance for Private VPC - proposal

Hi team,

We're preparing the next maintenance for the Private deployment serving Acme (VPC, dedicated private control plane). This thread is to lock down preflight checks, version-gating, maintenance window, and the rollback plan so we can get sign-off. High-level proposal below.

Proposed maintenance window (prelim):
- Candidate window: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 01:00 - 05:00 UTC (we can shift based on your blackout calendar)

Scope and goals:
- Apply security patches + runtime bump (serving runtime 1.3.0 -> 1.3.2).
- Minor model runtime tweaks (no model weights changes).
- Validate KV-cache compatibility and quantization flags.

Key operational controls (preflight + gating):
- Version pinning: target runtime 1.3.2 pinned on customer nodes; keep 1.3.0 as fallback variant.
- Canary cohort: 2% traffic for 30 minutes -> 10% for 45 minutes -> 100% if metrics stable.
- Health gates: 95th p95 latency threshold, error rate <= 0.5%, token cost within ±5% of baseline.
- KMS/HSM: no key material changes during patch; KMS rotation postponed until post-maintenance unless Acme requires otherwise.

Rollbacks and runbook summary:
- Immediate automated rollback to 1.3.0 on any health-gate breach.
- Manual rollback path outlined in attachment: rollback_matrix_v1.csv.

Attachments included: patch_manifest_v1.3.yml, network_diagram_vpc.pdf, rollback_matrix_v1.csv (draft).

Action items for Acme Ops (please reply with availability / blackout windows and explicit APPROVE to proceed):
1) Confirm blackout windows and any regional constraints.
2) Confirm KMS/HSM constraints (can we postpone rotation?).
3) Approve proposed canary percentages and timing.

Please reply by EOD Tue, 20 Apr so engineering can finalize the runbook.

Thanks,
Ben

Thanks Jamal — the Sunday slot works for our SRE rotation. A couple of clarifications from the ops/runbook side: 

- Canary cohorts: we'll implement traffic-splitting at the routing layer with sticky session affinity off for the first 30 minutes. If the customer-side code relies on affinity, we should flag it (please confirm, Jamal).
- Version gating: we'll publish the 1.3.2 variant under the same model alias and tag it as "canary-1.3.2". Fallback to 1.3.0 will use a hard pin in the routing table.
- Observability: add a short synthetic prompt set (10 prompts) to the canary to validate semantic quality before increasing traffic. That will catch subtle regressions.

I've added a short confluence note here: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PRIV/Private+Deployment+Upgrade+Runbook — includes the synthetic prompt sets.

Marissa

Quick technical questions to ensure we don't block during the window: 
1) KMS/HSM rotation: Jamal, you said rotation is postponed — can you confirm no automatic rotation jobs run during the maintenance window? If there's any scheduled rotation we need the cron details.
2) Database migrations: we don't have DB schema changes in this release, but we will update runtime metadata in the customer control plane. Is there any JSON blob size constraint on your side that could affect our rollout?
3) Rolling strategy: for the node-level upgrade we plan a rolling-restart with drain+verify. We need a list of on-call contacts and expected SSH jump host windows in case we need to run a manual rollback.

I've attached the KMS checklist we run post-upgrade (kms-rotation-checklist.md). I also think we should add a short escalation matrix to the rollback_matrix_v1.csv — I'll update it if you give the go-ahead.

Thanks for the quick replies and the blackout calendar, Jamal. Updated plan below based on your constraints: 

Updated maintenance window:
- Final window: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 02:00 - 06:00 UTC (Acme-approved).

Canary & gating adjustments (final):
- 0.5% synthetic canary for 30 minutes (initial smoke + synthetic prompts).
- 2% traffic for 45 minutes with observability checks (latency p95, error rate, semantic similarity on synthetic prompts).
- 10% for 1 hour. If all gates green, proceed to 100% in 15-minute increments.

Rollback matrix summary (attached):
- Immediate auto-fall back to pinned 1.3.0 variant if error rate exceeds 0.5% or p95 increases by >200ms.
- Manual rollback if we detect semantic drift or degraded downstream integration (DB, auth). Manual rollback RTM target: 20 minutes.

KMS/HSM & rotation:
- Jamal: please confirm there are no automatic KMS rotations scheduled 24-26 Apr. If confirmed, we'll keep rotation out of the critical path.

Operational preflight checklist (short):
- Network: firewall rules (Sheila) — final IP list delivered 48h prior.
- Observability: synthetic prompt set seeded 1 hour before canary.
- Backout: rollback_matrix_v1.csv attached; SRE on-call (Marissa) and runtime lead (Karthik) to accept pager duties.

Approval request: please reply to this thread with APPROVE from both Acme Ops and Redwood SRE leads by EOD Thu, 22 Apr to lock the schedule and trigger the runbook freeze.
